tasks.gr9-processing-materials-t4: Topic: Processing of metals, food and plastics. Cover corrosion prevention (galvanising, electroplating), food preservation methods (freezing, canning, drying), plastic processing and recycling, and processing choices. Ask Grade 9 learners to compare processing methods, select suitable materials for applications, evaluate environmental and economic impacts, create process-flow diagrams, analyze corrosion prevention strategies, and justify sustainability choices.
tasks.gr9-technology-society-t4: Topic: Technology in society and exam consolidation. Cover systems integration, sustainability, safety, communication of designs, PAT work review, and exam-style responses. Ask Grade 9 learners to analyze technology systems and their societal impact, evaluate trade-offs between environmental, economic, and social factors, present design solutions clearly with diagrams and justifications, connect practical PAT work to theoretical concepts, and synthesize knowledge across all four terms.
